response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials (TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling) and some genuinely relevant background — notably C/C++ work on the LabWindows/CVI IDE and authoring developer tooling libraries and test runners in D. However, the role demands strong Java and Kotlin expertise with deep JVM understanding and solid Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience, and the resume shows almost none of this: Java appears only as a peripheral mention in a 2016–2018 robotics/mobile-orchestration role, Kotlin is absent entirely, and no enterprise JVM frameworks, build tools, or application servers are referenced. The bulk of the last decade is TypeScript/Node.js and D. The gap on the core required technical stack is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise-framework IDE subsystems from day one.
strengths: Prior IDE development experience (LabWindows/CVI in C/C++)
Deep developer-tooling background: test runners, assertion libraries, MCP generators
Strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and public speaking/teaching
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin experience and only minimal, dated Java exposure
No Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, Gradle/Maven, or application server experience
Recent decade focused on TypeScript/Node and D, not JVM ecosystems
